description.zh:
通知范围。该值为JSONArray格式，包含以下KEY：
- **type**：通知范围类型。取值如下：
- **configItemList**：检测项通知配置列表，该值为JSONArray格式，包含以下KEY：
    - **key**：检测项通知配置KEY。
    - **valueList**：检测项通知配置值，该值为JSONArray格式。

> 取值请参考“参数补充说明”。
description.en:
The alerts for which you want the chatbot to send notifications. The value is a JSON array that contains the following fields:

*   **type**: the types of alerts. The valid values are listed in the "Additional description of parameters" section in this topic.

*   **configItemList**: the list of check items. The value is a JSON array that contains the following fields:

    *   **key**: the key of the check item.
    *   **valueList**: the values of the check item. The value of valueList is a JSON array.

> For more information about the value of this parameter, see the "Addition description of parameters" section in this topic.

The language of the notifications. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

description.zh:
通知的检测威胁资产分组编号。该值为JSONArray格式。

> 该值为JSONArray格式，您可以通过调用[DescribeGroupStruct](~~DescribeGroupStruct~~)接口获取资产分组编号。
description.en:
The IDs of asset groups for which you want the chatbot to send notifications. The value is a JSON array.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupStruct](~~DescribeGroupStruct~~) operation to query the IDs of asset groups.

description.zh:
指定要修改的通知机器人ID。
>您可以调用[DescribeDingTalk](~~DescribeDingTalk~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the chatbot.

> You can call the [DescribeDingTalk](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/security-center/developer-reference/api-sas-2018-12-03-describedingtalk/?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.681e4360Qd1eb1) operation to query the IDs of chatbots.

description.zh:
通知频率，单位秒。
> 值为**0**则表示不限制通知频率。
description.en:
The time interval at which the chatbot sends notifications.

> The value **0** indicates unlimited.

description.zh:
机器人名称。

> 钉钉通知名称的长度为2-64个字符。
description.en:
The name of the chatbot.

> The name of a chatbot must be 2 to 64 characters in length.

title.zh: 修改钉钉机器人通知配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-or-update-ding-talk --id 1589 --rule-action-name testNotify --send-url https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=XXX --interval-time 0 --config-list type_:_sas_analysis_online-sas-operation-log-sas-event-suspicious_,_configItemList_:_key_:_item_level_,_valueList_:_all_,_key_:_event_type_,_valueList_:_all --group-id-list 10417151 --ding-talk-lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas CreateOrUpdateDingTalk --region cn-hangzhou --GroupIdList 10417151 --RuleActionName testNotify --Id 1589 --IntervalTime 0 --SendUrl 'https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=XXX' --ConfigList 'type_:_sas_analysis_online-sas-operation-log-sas-event-suspicious_,_configItemList_:_key_:_item_level_,_valueList_:_all_,_key_:_event_type_,_valueList_:_all' --DingTalkLang zh
